# Single-Teacher Foundations

These methods establish the generative or on-policy distillation machinery used by later MOPD work, but use one teacher rather than multiple independent supervisors.

**3 records · catalog refreshed on 2026-10-05 · [Taxonomy](../resources/taxonomy.md)**

## Hybrid

<a id="arxiv-2402-03898"></a>
- [DistiLLM: Towards Streamlined Distillation for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.03898) - 2024-02-06. Introduces skew-KL objectives and an efficient online distillation pipeline for large language models.
  - **Facets:** `arxiv:2402.03898` · Method · Hybrid · State: Mixed
  - **Teacher topology:** Single Teacher
  - **Mechanism:** Direct Matching · Secondary: Dynamic Scheduling
  - **Signals and domains:** Logits / Distribution · General LLMs
  - **Classification evidence:** DistiLLM adaptively mixes fixed samples with reused student-generated outputs under one teacher, so only part of its state distribution is current-student induced.
  - **Artifacts:** None verified


## On Policy

<a id="arxiv-2306-13649"></a>
- [On-Policy Distillation of Language Models: Learning from Self-Generated Mistakes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.13649) - 2023-06-23. GKD formalizes language-model distillation on student-generated sequences and unifies several divergence objectives.
  - **Facets:** `arxiv:2306.13649` · Method · On Policy · State: Current Student
  - **Teacher topology:** Single Teacher
  - **Mechanism:** Direct Matching · Secondary: None
  - **Signals and domains:** Logits / Distribution · General LLMs
  - **Classification evidence:** GKD directly matches one teacher on sequences generated by the current student and therefore supplies the single-teacher OPD foundation.
  - **Artifacts:** None verified

<a id="arxiv-2306-08543"></a>
- [MiniLLM: Knowledge Distillation of Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.08543) - 2023-06-14. Develops reverse-KL-based generative LLM distillation with student-sampled behavior and practical stabilization methods.
  - **Facets:** `arxiv:2306.08543` · Method · On Policy · State: Current Student
  - **Teacher topology:** Single Teacher
  - **Mechanism:** Direct Matching · Secondary: None
  - **Signals and domains:** Logits / Distribution · General LLMs
  - **Classification evidence:** The student samples behavior for reverse-KL distillation, but supervision comes from one teacher model.
  - **Artifacts:** [Code](https://github.com/microsoft/LMOps/tree/main/minillm)
